name: strokegpt-revibed
comment: ESM marker only. The repo intentionally has no npm dependencies and no build step. This file exists so Node (when present) treats static/js/*.js as ES modules, matching how the browser loads them via <script type="module">. Without this, the Backlog #13 frontend behavioral test runner (tests/test_frontend_runtime.py) cannot import the production browser modules. See AGENTS.md > Frontend Behavioral Tests.
